explanation: Mathlib has no pivotal categories and no `doubleRightDualFunctor`; I found no matching names anywhere in Mathlib. The theorem says the inverse of the pivotal component at the unit equals the inverse unit comparison η of the double right dual functor. The nearest general ingredients are `NatTrans.IsMonoidal` and the instance `NatTrans.IsMonoidal e.inv` for `e.hom` monoidal, both in `Mathlib/CategoryTheory/Monoidal/NaturalTransformation.lean`. The `unit` field of `IsMonoidal` for `e.inv` would give an equation about ε, not η. It would still need `Functor.Monoidal.ε_η` and the pivotal-specific definitions, so it does not give a one- or two-line derivation. I also found no Mathlib lemma of the form "the inverse of a monoidal iso's component at the unit is η".
